notes.title: Now on PSVR!
notes.content:
Hello Ping Pongers,


Your favourite Virtual Ping Pong game has just made its way onto PlayStation VR.

[img]https://i.gyazo.com/6e06abe450eed232a3397157d7d5f1dd.png[/img]

Now you can bring the stadium into the comfort of your living room.

If you're interested in keeping up the fun, check out the links below:

[*][url=https://store.playstation.com/#!/en-gb/games/vr-ping-pong/cid=EP1121-CUSA06032_00-0000000000000000]UK Store page[/url]
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C2MLcMR2XLg&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Even More Updates! Arcade Mode, Power, Physics Tweaks and More!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

  Thanks for your continued support and great feedback! We've got more updates for you.

[b]What's new in this update:[/b]
[list][*]GOALMODE: New arcade mode. Players have to win as many sets as possible (with leaderboard)
[*]More power when serving the ball
[*]Some small physics adjustments
[*]New ball texture that makes the spin more visible
[*]Fixed the bug in the menu[/list]

  Also introducing a new easter egg ;)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Y5MXtNj.png[/img]

notes.title: More Updates! Leaderboard, Height and Distance Options!
notes.content:
Hi VR Ping Pong Enthusiasts!

Thanks for all the comments on social media and the community hub here on Steam.

We've been listening carefully to what you have been saying. The most common questions we get are:
[list][*]The table is too low!
[*]The table is too high!
[*]I'm too close to the table!
[*]I'm stuck inside the table! :P[/list]

Well this update is for you! Introducing: Player Height and Distance Settings! :D

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4CZEWjp.gif[/img]

[b]What's new in this update:[/b]
[list][*]Wall-mode Leaderboard
[*]Ability to choose the player's height relative to the table.
[*]Ability to choose the player distance from the table. (Depth)
[*]New 11-0 Achievement (Win a set 11-0)[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Ball Colors
[*]Edge shots[/list]

Bonus gif! Previously, we had the option to rotate the paddle. Here's how:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/F0dMwJe.gif[/img]

tags.feature: Wall-mode Leaderboard
Ability to choose the player's height relative to the table.
Ability to choose the player distance from the table. (Depth)
New 11-0 Achievement (Win a set 11-0)

notes.title: VR Ping Pong Update - Serve Methods, Racket Options, Haptic Feedback & More.
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks for all the suggestions over on the Community Hub. We have an update for you! Take a look below for the change log.

What's new:
[list][*]Ability to choose One Hand or Two Handed serve method (within the options menu)
[*]Rotate the racket (within the options menu)
[*]Logo has been added to the ball (to see ball spin better)
[*]Stronger haptic feedback for ball impact on the paddle
[*]Use any button for the AI or player serve
[*]One new stadium environment
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uScV86v.gif[/img]
